Salmon DNA Water Oil is an advanced bi-phase skincare treatment formulated with 59% active ingredients to support skin regeneration and barrier repair. This innovative formula combines a water phase and an oil phase to deliver both deep hydration and nourishment in a single step. The water phase is enriched with Polynucleotides (PDRN), RejuveNAD, and Epitensive to help promote cellular renewal, improve firmness, boost elasticity, and support overall skin vitality. The oil phase works to strengthen the skin’s lipid barrier, locking in moisture and preventing dehydration for long-lasting hydration. Working together, these phases help smooth skin texture, restore radiance, and improve the appearance of tired or aging skin, leaving the complexion visibly stronger, more luminous, and rejuvenated.
